title: Choose the KnowMIS visual world
question: The roll assigned the Tesserae direction. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Tesserae
options.lineage: Roman and Byzantine floor and wall mosaics (Salerno, Paestum)
options.thesis: Granular computing made literal: coarse tiles of data resolve into understanding as the page sharpens.
options.viewport: A full-width mosaic of coarse tiles refining into the KnowMIS wordmark and the line From data to understanding; a granularity control sets the resolution.
options.risk: Reads as pixel-art decoration if the resolve is not tied to the three SA acts below.

raised.raise: Each Situation Awareness act (perceive, comprehend, project) owns one full-bleed field and one idea, with staccato tile swaps between acts.

options.label: Olivetti Programma
options.thesis: Italy's own information-systems heritage: flat colour, rigorous grid, a confident machine voice.
options.viewport: A modular poster grid with the logo set as a stamp and the director named in the colophon.
options.risk: Familiar academic-design shorthand; nostalgia if the grid is loose.

options.label: Saul Bass Title Sequence
options.thesis: One idea per full-bleed card, built from black silhouettes on flat colour.
options.viewport: Timed full-bleed cards: data, awareness, decision.
options.case: Fuses well with SA's stages and is bold; loses on identifying researchers and partners.
options.risk: Reads as film promo, not a lab.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.case: The lab has no verified numbers to count.
options.kept: Total commitment to one warm accent.

options.label: Game Boy Four-Shade Field
options.case: Playful but undersells a research lab to partners.

options.label: Curved-Crease Shell
options.case: Beautiful but abstract; does not say what the lab does.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean university-lab page, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Navy hero with the logo, research areas as a card row, team grid.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other lab page.
